background: National Westminster Bank is the main ring-fenced bank of NatWest Group, funded by UK personal and business deposits and lending on residential mortgages and to UK companies, where it is the largest business lender.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest at A+, all on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. The ratings are stronger than the ratios: CET1 of 11.2% and leverage of 4.4% are both in the bottom quarter of UK majors, and LCR of 137% is in the bottom quarter too, having fallen 11 points since 30 Sep 2025. NSFR of 131% is above the peer median and the capital ratios have been broadly flat. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
